name: work-dazi
description: A personal work buddy that turns casual messages into prioritized tasks and pushes a daily kickoff reminder.

displayDescription.en: Recognizes casual work messages, breaks them into prioritized tasks, and pushes a daily kickoff reminder.
displayDescription.zh: 识别你随手发的工作消息，自动拆解任务并按优先级排程，每日推送开工提醒，帮你聚焦最重要的事。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我把刚发的几条消息整理成今天的待办清单，并按优先级排好
defaultInitPrompt.en: Turn my recent messages into a prioritized to-do list for today

quickPrompts.en: Turn my recent messages into a prioritized to-do list for today
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我把刚发的几条消息整理成今天的待办清单，并按优先级排好

quickPrompts.en: Build today's schedule sorted by priority
quickPrompts.zh: 按优先级给我的任务排个今天的时间表

quickPrompts.en: Remind me the top 3 things to start tomorrow morning
quickPrompts.zh: 提醒我明天上午最该先开工做的三件事
